senses.gloss:
बुष n. (-षं)
 1. Chaff.
 2. Water; also बुस.

बुस n. (-सं)
 1. Chaff. rubbish, refuse.
 2. Wealth.
 3. Dry cow-dung.
 4.
The thick part of sour curds.
 f. (-सा) A younger sister, (in
theatrical language.)
 E. बुस् to abandon, aff. क; also बुष, स being
changed to ष ।
बुस् r. 4th cl. (बुस्यति) To dismiss, to loose, to quit or leave.

बुस्त r. 10th cl. (बुस्तयति-ते)
 1. To regard, to respect.
 2. To disregard, to treat with disrespect.

बुस्त n. (-स्तं)
 1. Fried meat.
 2. The inner part of the jack fruit.
 E. बुस्त
to disrespect, aff. अच् ।
